campaignLine: Every Dachi Has a Matcha. Find Yours.
dachiMeaning: Matcha (Japanese green tea) + dachi (friend). Matcha is best enjoyed with friends.

blends.name: Dachi Blend
blends.line: For friends starting out, or who like it sweet and creamy.
points: Level 1 is gentle, Level 2 is stronger
blends.imageAlt: Ichicha strawberry matcha latte on a café table

blends.name: Japan Blend
blends.line: For friends who like full-bodied, complex matcha.
blends.imageAlt: Three Japan Blend matcha drinks on a café table

blendsFooter: At Matchadachi, all friends are welcome. Whisked for different tastes, the same love for matcha.

branches.name: Matchadachi Bulihan
branches.address: Blas Ople Road, Bulihan, Malolos, Bulacan
branches.note: Near La Consolacion University. Full menu with rice bowls, pasta and snacks.
